verses.pali: “Tiṇṇaṁ, bhikkhave, sammukhībhāvā saddho kulaputto bahuṁ puññaṁ pasavati.
verses.english: “Mendicants, when three things are present, a faithful gentleman brims with much merit.

verses.pali: Saddhāya, bhikkhave, sammukhībhāvā saddho kulaputto bahuṁ puññaṁ pasavati.
Deyyadhammassa, bhikkhave, sammukhībhāvā saddho kulaputto bahuṁ puññaṁ pasavati.
verses.english: when a gift to give is present,

verses.pali: Dakkhiṇeyyānaṁ, bhikkhave, sammukhībhāvā saddho kulaputto bahuṁ puññaṁ pasavati.
verses.english: and when those worthy of a religious donation are present.

verses.pali: Imesaṁ kho, bhikkhave, tiṇṇaṁ sammukhībhāvā saddho kulaputto bahuṁ puññaṁ pasavatī”ti.
verses.english: When these three things are present, a faithful gentleman brims with much merit.”
